title: Turkish-Style Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Turkish-inspired stir fry made with leeks and turkey.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the turkey breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the turkey from the skillet and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the sliced leeks and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, paprika, and cumin. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked turkey back into the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
